# Head of Courier Operations
## Sauce provided pay range
### Base pay range
$120,000.00/yr - $150,000.00/yr
Direct message the job poster from Sauce
[Vladimir Slavkovski](https://mk.linkedin.com/in/vladimirslavkovski)

...

### Vladimir Slavkovski
Sauce is a premier restaurant technology platform empowering chain brands and independent operators to accelerate revenue growth through our Commission-Free Delivery & Pickup framework and proprietary fulfillment optimization engine. Serving a $105B US local restaurant market, Sauce is headquartered in New York City, Miami and Tel Aviv.

...

**The Role**
Courier operations is one of Sauce's two main growth bets. We are hiring our first Head of Courier Operations to build the US courier function from the ground up, starting in New York City and Miami.

...

* Own courier supply end to end in NYC and Miami: active couriers, shift coverage, on-time rate, retention and cost per delivery.
* Build capacity planning: forecast courier hours needed by market, zone and time slot from order volume, and staff ahead of restaurant go-lives, seasonal peaks and weather.
* Design pay, incentive and bonus programs that hit coverage targets within the unit-economics budget.

...

**Lead the team**
* Hire, train and manage Courier Operations Managers in NYC and Miami.
* Set weekly targets, run performance reviews and coach the team in the field.
* Present weekly supply health, courier cost and unit economics to leadership.
**What You Bring**

...

* 6+ years in courier, driver or last-mile operations, including 3+ at a delivery marketplace or last-mile operator (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Instacart, Gopuff, Relay, Amazon DSP or similar).
* Built or scaled an independent courier program, including recruiting, scheduling and pay, ideally from an early stage.
* Hands-on knowledge of contractor engagement and compliance in delivery: classification, contracts, pay reconciliation, documentation.
* 2+ years managing people, including field-based teams.
* Strong analytical skills: capacity planning, unit economics and dashboards in Excel/Sheets (SQL a plus).
* Track record of working with Legal, Finance and Product to turn operational problems into processes.
* Valid driver's license and a personal vehicle; in the field most days.

...

* Experience with NYC delivery worker laws or similar courier pay rules.
* Spanish fluency (required if based in Miami).
* Launched or run courier operations in more than one US metro.
* Experience with Shipday, Onfleet, Bringg or similar dispatch platforms, and contractor payment tools.

...

* Competitive base salary plus performance bonus (see the Market Research tab).
* Mileage reimbursement for all work-related driving under Sauce's expense policy.
* Health, dental and vision; PTO and holidays; 401(k).
* Seniority level
  Director
* Employment type
  Full-time
* Industries
  Technology, Information and Internet

...
